component.name: ComfortAir
component.description: Designed to be able to process atmosphere to above UEE standards, the ComfortAir life support system from Tyler Design & Tech provides you and your crew with a clean and comfortable environment.

component.name: CoolCore
component.description: The name CoolCore says it all. Designed by Juno Starwerk to be as hardworking as you are, this cooler helps ensure that your entire ship operates well within desired temperature parameters.

component.name: SafeTow S3 Towing Beam
component.description: The safe and secure choice of recovery teams across the empire, the SafeTow towing beam from Greycat Industrial boasts enough strength, power, and control to transport both heavy cargo and vehicles across the ‘verse.

component.name: Diligence
component.description: Though the Diligence delivers high performance compared to other components in its class, this power plant’s dependability and ease of maintenance is what makes it a favorite of haulers.

component.name: 5MA 'Chimalli'
component.description: Thanks to Behring’s expert engineers, the 5MA ‘Chimalli’ shield generator balances the need for a solid regeneration rate with dependable damage absorption.

component.name: Huracan
component.description: Juno Starwerk understands that your most important job is to keep your cargo safe. That’s why their Huracan quantum drive prioritizes interdiction shielding, stability, and damage efficiency above everything else.

component.name: Excelsior
component.description: Journey across the ‘verse with Tarsus’ Excelsior jump module, offering greater reliability to help take your wanderlust to new heights.

component.name: Surveyor-Lite
component.description: There’s a lot for you to worry about on those long hauls. Don’t let your radar’s performance be one of them. You can count on the Surveyor-Lite from Chimera Communications to provide the durability and performance that you need.
